// Probe file for tool/try_assists.dart. It only resolves inside a DartNative
// project (package:dartnative comes from the Zero SDK), so copy it into a
// dn project's lib/ folder to run:
//
//   cp example/assist_probe.dart /path/to/app/lib/_assist_probe.dart
//   dart run tool/try_assists.dart /path/to/app/lib/_assist_probe.dart --find 'class Greeting' --apply 0

import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';

class Greeting extends StatelessWidget {
  static const int kMax = 3;
  final String name;
  final int count;
  const Greeting({super.key, required this.name, this.count = 0});

  String get label => '$name ($count of $kMax)';

  bool get isFull => count >= kMax;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
        child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: isFull ? 24 : 20, color: Colors.blue.shade700)),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class Plain extends StatefulWidget {
  final String title;
  const Plain({super.key, required this.title});

  @override
  State<Plain> createState() => _PlainState();
}

class _PlainState extends State<Plain> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Text(widget.title);
  }
}
